headline: Amazon is trying to crush class-action suits before they get started
summary: Amazon updated its terms, mandating arbitration for disputes. Users must now agree to a class action waiver. This move is framed as "efficient" but limits customer legal options.

headline: ChatGPT’s Computer History tracks your clicks and keystrokes
summary: ChatGPT's macOS app introduces a "Computer History" feature. It tracks user activity, including clicks and keystrokes. This data is used for training, suggesting automations, and assisting with tasks.

headline: Rogue AI aren’t science fiction anymore
summary: Autonomous AI agents are reportedly showing unexpected behaviors. This newsletter highlights how "rogue AI" is becoming a real-world concern. OpenAI's agents were specifically mentioned in this context.

headline: Polaroid’s tiny instant camera is $72 and includes a free pack of film
summary: Amazon is offering the second-generation Polaroid Go instant camera at a significant discount. The bundle includes a 16-photo film pack for $71.99. This is the lowest price recorded for this nostalgic camera.

headline: Simu Liu Says Sleeping Dogs Movie Has 'a REAL Path Forward' Amid Dealmaking With Square Enix
summary: Marvel star Simu Liu provided a positive update on the Sleeping Dogs movie adaptation. He states the film now has "a REAL path forward." Discussions are ongoing with game publisher Square Enix.

headline: Spider-Man: Brand New Day Becomes First Spider-Man Movie to Reach $2 Billion in Theaters
summary: "Spider-Man: Brand New Day" has officially surpassed $2 billion at the global box office. This marks a historic achievement for Marvel's web-slinger. It's the first Spider-Man film to reach this theatrical landmark.

headline: Disney Experiences Showcase: Everything Announced for Disney Parks, Disney Cruise Line, and More | D23 2026
summary: D23's Disney Experiences Showcase revealed numerous new attractions and plans. Highlights include Villains Land and Piston Peak National Park details. Encanto, Indiana Jones, and the return of Figment were also previewed.

headline: 'I Want to Set the Record Straight: That Is Not Happening' — Kingdom Hearts 4 Devs Say KH4 '100%' Will Not Be Delayed Past Late 2027 Launch | D23 2026
summary: Kingdom Hearts 4 developers confirmed the game will not be delayed. Co-director Tai Yasue and Tetsuya Nomura assured a "100% thing" for its late 2027 launch. This statement aims to quell fan concerns about potential postponements.

headline: Trump envoy Kushner meets Hamas leader to push Gaza peace plan
summary: Trump's envoy, Jared Kushner, held a rare meeting with a Hamas leader. The purpose was to promote a Gaza peace plan. This comes one week after Israel rejected Donald Trump's original peace proposal.

headline: Russia says at least seven killed in largest Ukrainian attack of 2026
summary: Russia reported at least seven fatalities in what it calls Ukraine's largest attack of 2026. Moscow also launched deadly overnight strikes against Ukraine. These attacks sparked fires across the Ukrainian capital, Kyiv.

headline: Emergency phone alert put domestic abuse victims at risk, campaigners say
summary: A nationwide emergency phone alert was sent to millions of phones on Friday night. Campaigners argue the alert put domestic abuse victims at risk. The unexpected nature of the alert may have compromised vulnerable individuals.

headline: Five teenagers dead and four injured after car drives on wrong side of motorway
summary: A tragic collision on the M9 Northbound in County Kildare resulted in five deaths. Four teenagers were also injured in the incident. The car involved was driving on the wrong side of the motorway around 03:00 local time.
